split_rule: Connected components of all gold/original evidence pages, claim and subject; holdout component size <=8, development <=40; whole-component capacity packing before model evaluation
limitations: Shared unknown events or unrecognized paraphrases may remain; page/subject grouping does not prove independence.
NEI retrieved sentences are auxiliary, not annotated sufficient evidence.
Pretrained models may have seen FEVER; model pretraining leakage cannot be excluded.

rights.policy: Local research only. External text and derived datasets are not part of Apache code distribution. No AVeriTeC. Preserve attribution; obtain redistribution review before publication.
